script:
#!/bin/bash
# 把 vault-data.js 同步到 VPS：先从 API 元数据取期望字节数，再拉 raw，两者一致才覆盖。
# raw.githubusercontent 是 CDN，覆盖同名文件后会返回旧内容，所以统一走 API raw 视图。
set -u
API="https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/vault-data.js?ref=main"
TMP=/tmp/_vault_new.js

META=$(curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
       -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
       -H "User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync" "$API")
EXPECT=$(printf '%s' "$META" | tr ',' '\n' | grep -m1 '"size"' | tr -dc '0-9')
echo "API 记录字节: ${EXPECT:-未知}"

curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" \
     -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
     -H "User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync" "$API" -o "$TMP" || { echo "下载失败"; exit 1; }

SIZE=$(stat -c %s "$TMP")
echo "下载字节: $SIZE"
if [ -n "${EXPECT:-}" ] && [ "$SIZE" != "$EXPECT" ]; then
  echo "字节数与 API 元数据不符，未覆盖"; exit 2
fi
grep -q 'PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256' "$TMP" || { echo "结构异常（不是加密信封），未覆盖"; exit 3; }
grep -o '"generatedAt": "[^"]*"' "$TMP" | head -1

sudo install -m 644 -o root -g root "$TMP" /var/www/xinmo-site/vault-data.js
ls -l /var/www/xinmo-site/vault-data.js
echo "---- 站外自检（只看信封头，不打印密文）----"
curl -fsS "https://xinmo.work/vault-data.js?t=$(date +%s)" | grep -o '"generatedAt": "[^"]*"' | head -1
